fusions.name: Muck Drag
fusions.desc: Primes up to 3 bodies in reach. Each bursts for 14 damage the moment an enemy comes near and knocks it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Raked Reeds
fusions.desc: Flings a reed spear that deals 8 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Gather Strays
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Leavings Linger
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% nature resistance for as long as you carry it.
